1.text: “Icyo gihe ubwami bwo mu ijuru buzagereranywa n'abakobwa cumi bajyanye amatabaza yabo, bajya gusanganira umukwe.

2.text: Ariko muri abo cumi, abatanu bari abapfu, abandi batanu bari abanyabwenge.

3.text: Abapfu bajyanye amatabaza yabo ntibajyana n'amavuta,

4.text: ariko abanyabwenge bo bajyana amavuta mu mperezo zabo hamwe n'amatabaza yabo.

6.text: “Ariko nijoro mu gicuku habaho urusaku ngo ‘Umukwe araje, nimusohoke mumusanganire!’

7.text: Maze ba bakobwa bose barahaguruka baboneza amatabaza yabo.

8.text: Abapfu babwira abanyabwenge bati ‘Nimuduhe ku mavuta yanyu, kuko amatabaza yacu azima.’

9.text: Ariko abanyabwenge barabahakanira bati ‘Oya, ntiyadukwira twese, ahubwo nimujye mu bahanjuzi muyigurire.’

10.text: Bagiye kugura, umukwe araza, abari biteguye binjirana na we mu bukwe, urugi rurakingwa.

11.text: “Hanyuma ba bakobwa bandi na bo baraza, barahamagara bati ‘Nyakubahwa, dukingurire.’

12.text: Na we arabasubiza ati ‘Ndababwira ukuri yuko ntabazi.’

13.text: “Nuko mube maso, kuko mutazi umunsi cyangwa igihe.

14.text: “Bizaba nk'iby'umuntu wari ugiye kuzindukira mu kindi gihugu, ahamagara abagaragu be abasigira ibintu bye,

15.text: aha umwe italanto eshanu, undi amuha ebyiri, undi amuha imwe uko umuntu ashoboye, arazinduka.

16.text: Uwo mwanya uwahawe italanto eshanu aragenda arazigenza, agenzuramo izindi talanto eshanu.

17.text: N'uwahawe ebyiri abigenza atyo, agenzuramo izindi ebyiri.

18.text: Ariko uwahawe imwe aragenda acukura umwobo, ahishamo italanto ya shebuja.

19.text: “Maze iminsi myinshi ishize, shebuja w'abo bagaragu araza, abarana na bo umubare w'ibyo yabasigiye.

20.text: Uwahawe italanto eshanu araza, azana izindi talanto eshanu ati ‘Databuja, wansigiye italanto eshanu, dore nazigenzuyemo izindi talanto eshanu.’

21.text: Shebuja aramubwira ati ‘Nuko nuko mugaragu mwiza ukiranuka, wakiranutse mu bike, nzakwegurira byinshi, injira mu munezero wa shobuja.’

22.text: “N'uwahawe italanto ebyiri araza aravuga ati ‘Databuja, wansigiye italanto ebyiri, dore nazigenzuyemo izindi ebyiri.’

23.text: Shebuja aramubwira ati ‘Nuko nuko mugaragu mwiza ukiranuka, wakiranutse mu bike, nzakwegurira byinshi, injira mu munezero wa shobuja.’

24.text: “N'uwahawe imwe araza aravuga ati ‘Databuja, nari nzi ko uri umunyamwaga, ko usarura aho utabibye, ko uhunika ibyo utagosoye

25.text: ndatinya, ndagenda mpisha italanto yawe mu butaka. dore ngiyo, ibyawe urabifite.’

26.text: “Ariko shebuja aramusubiza ati ‘Wa mugaragu mubi we, wa munyabute we, ko wari uzi ko nsarura aho ntabibye, mpunika ibyo ntagosoye,

27.text: italanto yawe ntiwari ukwiriye kuyiha abagenza, nanjye naza ukampana iyanjye n'inyungu yayo?

28.text: Nuko nimuyimwake, muyihe ufite italanto cumi.

29.text: Kuko ufite wese azahabwa akarushirizwaho, ariko udafite azakwa n'icyo yari afite.

30.text: N'uyu mugaragu nta cyo amaze, mumujugunye mu mwijima hanze. Ni ho bazaririra bakahahekenyera amenyo.’

31.text: “Umwana w'umuntu ubwo azazana n'abamarayika bose afite ubwiza bwe, ni bwo azicara ku ntebe y'ubwiza bwe.

32.text: Amahanga yose azateranirizwa imbere ye, abarobanure nk'uko umwungeri arobanura intama mu ihene,

33.text: intama azazishyira iburyo bwe, naho ihene azishyire ibumoso.

34.text: Umwami azabwira abari iburyo bwe ati ‘Nimuze mwebwe abo Data yahaye umugisha, muragwe ubwami bwabatunganirijwe uhereye ku kuremwa kw'isi,

35.text: kuko nari nshonje mukamfungurira, nari mfite inyota mumpa icyo nywa, nari umushyitsi murancumbikira,

36.text: nari nambaye ubusa muranyambika, nari ndwaye muransūra, nari mu nzu y'imbohe muza kundeba.’

37.text: “Abakiranutsi bazamubaza bati ‘Mwami, twakubonye ryari ushonje turagufungurira, cyangwa ufite inyota tuguha icyo unywa?

38.text: Kandi twakubonye ryari uri umushyitsi turagucumbikira, cyangwa wambaye ubusa turakwambika?

39.text: Kandi twakubonye ryari urwaye, cyangwa uri mu nzu y'imbohe tuza kugusūra?’

40.text: Umwami azabasubiza ati ‘Ndababwira ukuri yuko ubwo mwabikoreye umwe muri bene Data aba boroheje bari hanyuma y'abandi, ari jye mwabikoreye.’

41.text: “Azabwira n'abari ibumoso ati ‘Nimuve aho ndi mwa bivume mwe, mujye mu muriro w'iteka watunganirijwe Umwanzi n'abamarayika be,

42.text: kuko nari nshonje ntimumfungurire, nari mfite inyota ntimwampa icyo nywa,

43.text: nari umushyitsi ntimwancumbikira, nari nambaye ubusa ntimwanyambika, nari umurwayi no mu nzu y'imbohe ntimwansūra.’

44.text: “Na bo bazamusubiza bati ‘Mwami, twakubonye ryari ushonje, cyangwa ufite inyota, cyangwa uri umushyitsi, cyangwa wambaye ubusa, cyangwa urwaye, cyangwa uri mu nzu y'imbohe, ntitwagukorera?’

45.text: Azabasubiza ati ‘Ndababwira ukuri yuko ubwo mutabikoreye umwe muri bene Data aba boroheje bari hanyuma y'abandi, nanjye mutabinkoreye.’

46.text: Abo bazajya mu ihaniro ry'iteka, naho abakiranutsi bazajya mu bugingo buhoraho.”
